notFound.title: Organization not found
notFound.description: This record does not exist or has been deleted.

merged.notice: This record was absorbed by “{name}” on {date}. It stays available, and its former addresses keep working.

duplicates.title: Suspected duplicates
duplicates.description: This record appears in {count} unsettled pair. | This record appears in {count} unsettled pair. | This record appears in {count} unsettled pairs.

names.title: Names
names.description: Every way of designating this organization. Each one is searched — this is what prevents a second record being created under the acronym.
names.caption: Organization names
names.derivedHint: The legal name and acronym are copied by the database: they change on the record itself.
names.confirmedHint: A hidden name still serves search; it simply is not displayed.

domains.title: Email domains
domains.description: The most reliable matching signal: two records sharing a verified domain are the same body. A verified domain affiliates new sign-ups automatically.
domains.caption: Organization email domains
domains.autoJoinHint: Automatic affiliation requires a verified domain.
domains.taken: “{name}” already holds this verified domain. A verified domain belongs to one organization only — this is most likely a duplicate.

members.title: Members
members.description: Affiliations of this organization, pending ones included. The team can approve a request, appoint the contact and change a role: each action is recorded with its author.
members.caption: Organization members
members.invited: Invited on {date}: awaiting the person's answer

noManager.title: This organization has no contact
noManager.message: Nobody can approve a request from its workspace. Approve a request as “Contact”, or change a member's role.

members.awaitingPerson: Awaiting the person's answer. Nothing to approve here.
members.lastManagerRefused: This is the organization's last contact: confirm in the dialog to remove their role.

dialog.acceptIntro: {name} will join the organization with the chosen role and will be notified by email.

hint.manager: Approves requests, invites members, submits and tracks proposals.
hint.member: Submits and tracks the organization's proposals.
hint.contributor: Takes part in the proposals assigned to them.

lastManager.title: This is the organization's only contact
lastManager.message: Without a contact, nobody will be able to approve a request from the organization's workspace. Appoint another contact first, or confirm knowingly.

pendingValidation.title: Organization awaiting validation: its contact is provisional
pendingValidation.message: The person who created the organization can submit proposals, but cannot invite or approve anyone. When validating it, confirm this contact or appoint another one below.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Submissions and scheduled activities, in every role.
activities.caption: Organization activities

history.title: History
history.description: Every change to the record, field by field. History comes from the database audit log, including fixes made outside the interface.

merges.title: Merges
merges.rows: {count} item moved | {count} item moved | {count} items moved
